name: SWEEP-S3v1 Free minds
_design: Control arm for S2: the same seed, world, agents and instruction, but thinking costs nothing. Judged against S2 (skills written, via-skill share, observe spam, deaths), not on its own drama.

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are one of several agents living in this world. Nobody has given you a role, a team or a strategy; how you live is your own choice. Your one standing aim is to stay alive for as long as you can.
